title: Open Problems on Billiards and Geometric Optics
exact_target: Formulate the free-body dynamics in a rarefied particle medium in every positive dimension and prove existence and uniqueness, including the one-dimensional measure-valued particle model coupled to a point of mass one.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, \emph{UnsolvedMath: A Curated Collection of Open Mathematics Problems}, record 5200012 (AMR-051-0012). CC BY 4.0.
M. Bialy, C. Fierobe, A. Glutsyuk, M. Levi, A. Plakhov and S. Tabachnikov, \emph{Open problems on billiards and geometric optics} (2021), arXiv:2110.10750v2, Alexander Plakhov, Problem 3, p. 9.
